release.changelog:
build: update Android amnezia-box to 1.15.0-alpha.13-awgm.35

Pin ab29892ee9511775edb53918b8ec79eaa14be6fb and build with
gomobile/gobind v0.1.13 like upstream. Go stays on 1.25.5 per go.mod;
both Tor patches apply unchanged.

libbox removed PlatformInterface.useProcFS(), so drop the override.
Connection owners are still resolved via getConnectionOwnerUid().
